newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize up on tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize up on tight supply.

text.p: Argentine cash maize was mainly higher in tight trade midsession trade Tuesday at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange as supply dried up, traders said.

The FAS elevator maize price for delivery to Bahia Blanca and Quequen rose $2 and $1 respectively to $110. Sellers' concern about port storage space shortages strengthening buyers' bargaining position and the consequences of heavy recent rain clogging up transport both helped keep supply scarce, traders said. Rosario spot soybeans rose $2 in tight trade to $292, on crusher demand and nerves about the crop. Rosario sunflower seed rose $3 to $228 in tight trade.
